pages.title: SEO & Web Performance - September 2026
pages.subtitle: Technical progress, search visibility, delivery status, and measurable outcomes in one concise report.

pages.title: The month in one view
pages.intro: The strongest movement came from better technical stability and stronger ownership of high-value pages. The report is deliberately concise: what changed, what the numbers show, and where the next gains are likely to come from.

cards.label: Priority actions closed
cards.note: Two items moved to next cycle

blocks.text: The technical layer was stabilized first so later SEO work would not sit on top of avoidable performance and indexing noise. Rendering, crawlability, page ownership and internal linking were checked together rather than treated as unrelated tasks.

items: High-value pages received stronger contextual internal links.
Indexation checks were normalized so stale historical URLs stopped looking like active problems.
The reporting layer now separates actual movement from migration residue and old-site noise.
Core Web Vitals stayed inside the acceptable operating range while content changes were deployed.

blocks.text: The result is a cleaner base for future ranking work. Instead of spending the next cycle debugging infrastructure, effort can move toward authority, content depth, and external signals.

pages.title: Visibility trend
pages.analysis: The important signal is not the last data point by itself; it is the consistency of the slope after the technical changes. The line moved upward without a matching increase in crawl errors or performance regressions.
pages.source: Google Search Console and internal technical monitoring - September 2026

pages.title: نمونه صفحه فارسی و متن ترکیبی

blocks.text: در این دوره، رشد کلیک ارگانیک ادامه پیدا کرد و داده های Google Search Console نشان می دهد که صفحه example.com/patent مالکیت بهتری روی عبارت هدف پیدا کرده است. در همین بازه، Laravel 13.19 و Core Web Vitals نیز بدون افت محسوس پایدار ماندند.

items: عبارت های انگلیسی مثل Google Search Console باید در متن فارسی به هم نریزند.
عددهایی مثل 42.6%، آدرس example.com و نسخه Laravel 13.19 باید خوانا باقی بمانند.
اندازه متن نباید برای جا شدن صفحه به شکل نامحسوس کوچک شود.
اگر محتوا جا نشد، موتور باید خطای fit بدهد تا چت متن را کوتاه کند یا صفحه را تقسیم کند.

blocks.text: هدف این صفحه این است که قبل از هر استفاده واقعی، مشکل RTL و متن دو زبانه را به عنوان یک تست اجباری ببینیم، نه چیزی که بعداً در نسخه نهایی کشف شود.

pages.title: Clear work. Clear evidence. No report noise.
pages.text: The report system is designed to make the useful information easier to read, not to fill pages with decoration. When more detail is needed, the document grows. When less is needed, the composition changes instead of inventing filler.
